anonymized_feature_policy: Strictly preserved as numeric signals; do not invent real-world semantics for anonymized Kaggle IEEE-CIS fields (C1, D1, V100, card1-card6, addr1-addr2).

hour_of_day.description: Hour of day derived from relative timedelta TransactionDT modulo 24

day_of_week.description: Day of week derived from relative timedelta TransactionDT

is_night.description: Indicator for execution between 00:00 and 05:00 hours

is_weekend.description: Indicator for weekend execution (Saturday or Sunday)

product_code_encoded.description: Product code category (W, C, R, H, S)

card4_brand_encoded.description: Card network brand (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, Amex)

card1_freq.description: Empirical frequency of card1 issuing institution identifier in training partition

addr1_freq.description: Empirical frequency of addr1 billing location identifier in training partition

is_foreign_corridor.description: Indicator for addr2 foreign/cross-border destination mismatch

email_domain_risk.description: Risk score associated with purchaser email provider domain

has_identity.description: Presence of digital identity footprint or device fingerprint telemetry

is_mobile_device.description: Indicator for mobile device type telemetry

c1_velocity.description: Log(1 + C1) masked transaction frequency/velocity counter
c1_velocity.note: Preserved as masked numeric indicator; semantic definition not invented

d1_recency.description: Log(1 + D1) masked timedelta counter since previous transaction event
d1_recency.note: Preserved as masked numeric indicator; semantic definition not invented

v100_masked_signal.description: V100 engineered behavioral telemetry signal from Vesta corporation
v100_masked_signal.note: Preserved as masked numeric indicator; semantic definition not invented
